title: Algebraic stalk levels of a finite etale quotient system
statement: Let X be Noetherian, A a commutative Noetherian ring, J an ideal. Let C_n be bounded constructible coefficient-sized etale complexes over A/J^(n+1), all with Tor amplitude [a,b], with lisse finite-type cohomology at n=0 and specified consecutive derived reduction isomorphisms. Then X has a coefficient-small covering of its final proetale object by affine objects weakly contractible on the actual slices. On each member there are ordinary derived A/J^(n+1)-complexes E_n, with E_0 perfect, consecutive scalar-extension isomorphisms for the canonical module-derived scalar extension, and individual constant-realization isomorphisms to the restriction of the comparison of C_n. There is no completed complex among the hypotheses and no reconstruction among the conclusions. All comparisons and universes are those of [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons] and [def-sfb-module-derived-scalar-comparisons].

proof.text: Induct through the consecutive quotient maps. Each is surjective with square-zero kernel: its kernel is the image of J^(n+1) in A/J^(n+2), whose square vanishes. The given quotient isomorphism and bounded-above part of hC allow nilpotent-coefficient lissity reflection; start at the given residue lissity.

Apply the proved coefficient-sized connected-component contractible-cover construction. For each member choose its recorded point z and define E_n by the explicit exact derived stalk of C_n at the algebraic closure of the residue field of z. These are actual constructed stalks, not arbitrary witnesses.

Apply single-complex connected-stalk constancy at every level to obtain the required constant realization isomorphisms and perfect E_0. Compose the scalar-extension/stalk comparison with the stalk of beta n to obtain each algebraic consecutive quotient isomorphism.

theorem adicEtale_stalk_levels
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (C : ∀ n : ℕ, adicFiniteEtale.{u, v} X J n)
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, v}
      X (adicFiniteCoeff J n) (C n))
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hTor : ∀ n : ℕ, HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite
        (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A J n) (C n) a b)
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules
      (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)
      ((adicResidueCohomology
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite
          (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A J 0) q).obj (C 0)))
    (beta : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (adicFiniteExtension (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
        (adicFiniteFactor J (Nat.le_succ n))).obj (C (n + 1)) ≅ C n) :
    ∃ (I : Type (max v (u + 1)))
      (V : I → coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
      (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶
        (AsSmall.up : X.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X).obj (⊤_ X.ProEt)),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X _ ∧
      ∀ i : I,
        IsAffine ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj
          (V i)).left ∧
        AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X (V i) ∧
        ∃ E : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} (adicFiniteCoeff J n)),
          DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (E 0) ∧
          (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
            ((ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension
              (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc J (n + 1))).obj (E (n + 1)) ≅ E n)) ∧
          ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
            ((adicResidueFiniteConstant.{u, v} X J (V i) n).obj (E n) ≅
              (adicResidueRestriction
                (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite
                  (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J n) (V i)).obj
                  ((adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J n)).obj (C n)))
